name: Check how the reconstruction is sourced
description: Validates that the ship card, the placement card and the source list disclose where every reconstructed position comes from.

planSteps.description: Assert the ship card (data-testid ship-card) shows IMO 9329760, flag Cook Islands, and the sentence "Positions here are reconstructed from statements, never recorded."
Click the link "How each one is placed" in the ship card

Assert the card headed "How the track is placed" (data-testid placement-card) is in view and lists three positions at 10:26, 16:44 and 22:28, the first one "Over Estlink 2, about 55 km south of Loviisa"
Assert the source list (data-testid source-list) shows 18 numbered sources, each with a link that opens in a new tab, including "Fault detected in Cinia C-Lion1 submarine cable"
Assert the card headed "Since that night" lists "Court of Appeal overturns the dismissal and returns the case" dated 27 Aug 2026
